title: Constancy Theorem for top-dimensional integer multiplicity currents (Lemma B)
statement: Let m ∈ ℕ and n := m + 1. Let V ⊆ ℝⁿ be open, X ∈ 𝒟_n(V) integer multiplicity, and B ⊆ V open and preconnected, and suppose ∂X = 0 in B: X.boundary β (= X(dβ)) = 0 for every β ∈ 𝒟^m(V) (TestFormOn V m) with tsupport β ⊆ B. Then there is c ∈ ℤ such that X(ω) = c·∫_{ℝⁿ} ω(y)(e) dLⁿ(y) for every ω ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(V) with tsupport ω ⊆ B, where e = (e₁, …, eₙ) is the standard basis (EuclideanSpace.basisFun) — i.e. X = c[[B]] in B with the standard orientation.
lean_statement: ∀ (m : ℕ) (V B : Set (Euclid (m + 1))) (X : GeometricCurrentOn V (m + 1)), IsOpen V → IsIntegerMultiplicity X → IsOpen B → IsPreconnected B → B ⊆ V → (∀ β : TestFormOn V m, tsupport (β : DifferentialForm (Euclid (m + 1)) m) ⊆ B → X.boundary β = 0) → ∃ c : ℤ, ∀ ω : TestFormOn V (m + 1), tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid (m + 1)) (m + 1)) ⊆ B → X ω = (c : ℝ) * ∫ y, (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid (m + 1)) (m + 1)) y ⇑(EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin (m + 1)) ℝ)
